## A small fabric

- Two spine switches.
- Two leaf switches.
- Two hosts, one attached to each leaf.

Everything in this deck is illustrative. No lab resources are created.

::: {.notes}
Introduce the topology before moving to the next slide. These are native
Reveal.js speaker notes; press S in a browser to open the speaker view.

## 🔐 SSH to Nodes

## Build it in stages

::: {.incremental}
- Define nodes and links.
- Establish underlay reachability.
- Configure EVPN and VXLAN.
- Validate host-to-host traffic.
:::

## Roles and responsibilities

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Network

- Spines carry routed traffic.
- Leaves attach endpoints.
- EVPN distributes reachability.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Checks

| Layer | Check |
| :--- | :--- |
| Physical | Interfaces up |
| Underlay | Loopbacks reachable |
| Overlay | EVPN routes present |
:::
::::

## Read the configuration

```yaml
# This is a displayed code sample, not an executable cell.
fabric:
  name: preview-fabric
  spines: [spine-1, spine-2]
  leaves: [leaf-1, leaf-2]
  overlay: evpn-vxlan
```

Native Quarto highlighting should remain readable at presentation scale.
